correctness.rationale: The face formula is proved via total-support faces of the Birkhoff polytope, polyhedral projector cells and local strict complementarity, with both upper and lower Lipschitz inequalities. For n=2,3,4 all 3,49,7443 valid labeled supports are exhaustively grouped into 2,6,42 row–column relabeling orbits and each exact rational tangent projector checked: full support uniquely attains 1,16/9,9/4. The n=12 support is union of six cyclic permutations; its 72-term rational row entries have checked multiplicities summing to 41/12 and furnish a finite sign-witness quotient. No n=12 upper bound or first failure dimension is claimed. All actual standalone verifier assertions passed.

value.rationale: Coordinatewise perturbation stability matters when Frobenius nearest-point projection serves as a normalization or feasibility map. Exact classification for the first nonlinear orders shows active support loss does not worsen the affine bound through order four, while a highly symmetric degree-six support produces a strict norm increase at order twelve. This is a structural counterexample to full-support dominance, not a routine evaluation of a single arbitrary number: it distinguishes active nonnegative constraints from affine balancing and provides a reproducible exact obstruction. The unresolved intermediate and large-order constants are stated explicitly.
